channel.title: Lesotho - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Lesotho, every source cited.

item.title: China reaffirms ties and multilateralism with Lesotho
item.description: Ambassador Yang Xiaokun urged local media to respect China's sovereignty claims over Taiwan.

item.title: Lebona Lephema considers new party formation
item.description: Disgruntled tycoon Lebona Lephema may form a new political party if his bid to oust RFP deputy leader fails.

item.title: Mafeteng Hospital sued M2 million for alleged negligence
item.description: A patient claims faecal matter leaked into his body after a seven-day wait for medical attention post-surgery.

item.title: Lesotho to chair SADC security body
item.description: The nation takes over leadership of the SADC Organ on Politics, Defence and Security Cooperation after a decade under scrutiny.
